interface.shortDescription: Edinburgh student resources, coursework and planning
interface.longDescription: Student-first University of Edinburgh companion for Work and other MCP agents. Reuse your own campus login to find and read supported resources, download files, organise tasks and view an evidence-based agenda. Ten-language service catalog. Each person installs and connects independently. Independent open-source project; not an official University product. Staff administration and remote school writes are not implemented.
